01 | About Ezzy

JUST A MAN,
WITH BIG DREAMS.

Hi! I'm Ezzy, a creative multimedia designer driven by a passion to keep growing and pushing the limits of my craft. My creative journey began at the age of 15 when I first discovered the world of video editing — and I’ve been hooked ever since. Today, as a creative multimedia expert with over four years of experience in the creative industry, I’ve collaborated with multiple companies, bringing ideas to life through design and storytelling. I specialise in video editing, motion graphics, UI/UX, and visual effects. My goal? To become one of the best creators out there and inspire others!
